description: Take the acknowledgement (and any silence) off a firing incident, so it counts as unattended again and the pager resumes. Use it when you stop working an issue you acknowledged and no one else has it. `by` is recorded: History shows who handed it back.

by.description: Who is doing this, as "agent: <who>", for example "agent: claude in web-app". Required: it is shown on the tile, in the incident sheet and in History. "agent: " is added when left off. At most 64 characters.

key.description: The incident key exactly as watch_state or list_incidents print it ("<service>|<rule>", or "<service>|<rule>|<instance>" for a rule split per instance). Not an alert key.

note.description: A sentence of context, at most 500 characters: a fix commit, a PR, what you found. Longer findings go in a comment.

name: unacknowledge
title: Take an acknowledgement off
